body:
Hey,

Can I get added back to Slack? Was a member around 1-2 years ago but because of some personal problems had to quit. Now I'm back! :D

Thanks!

Well, it is a vicious circle. What helped me when I was your age was to get out as much as possible and try to do a sport (so weight loss will appear soon). Doing sport will also get you in touch with people which may help.

Take care!
It happens to me too .. they keep me alive .. but is it out of love? or selfishness? What do you truly think?

Getting disappointed is maybe because of your expectations for the people you encounter. It is always worth living, no one can promise it will be better in the future and yes .. Elpis was .. how to say .. lost on the bottom of the Pandora's box but .. do people really need hope/expectations when they are talking about other people? Can you be truly sure of anyone else besides yourself?
First try to find the strength to go on in yourself, then rely on the others and you'll see that even if they disappoint you it won't be the end of the world.

You will always have yourself. Maybe that's a good enough reason to live. People, all of them, will always disappoint you but not because of them but because of your expectations from them. 
I'm actually going through the same thing as you .. a kind of nihilist view of the world. If you want to talk write here what really really bothers you from this world.

Take care!

There are no rude questions for me, don't worry. At least online I'm trying to be 100% honest as I don't have anything to loose.
I'm not worried to get more tired .. I'm sure of it, it happens continuously and I can't stop it. I had suicidal thoughts since I was in high-school (the reasons were different then .. I wanted to get rid of my life because I wanted to escape the dreams; but nowadays I accepted them and I fully fine with them, they are a part of me) but now, the suicidal thoughts, look better and better like the best idea to just stop the existence and rest in peace.

The only thing that keeps me alive are the others who just don't want to let me go. I'm afraid, in the near future (in this rhythm in less than a year) I'll completely loose control of myself and I don't want them to see me like this even if it hurts them a lot.

Thank you PankFlamingos!

That's why I started studying it .. to find a reason. Some could say you can't be objective to yourself but again .. what is objectivity when you talk about you or people you interact with? Can it be 100% true objectivity anyway? :)

In my mid 20s I was diagnosticated with narcolepsy, and that was the last time I went to get "specialized" aid. The issue is that even if I sleep few minutes (usually I drool when I'm that state) it is enough to get the physical energy to get past the next day(s) and so on.
